function.name: browser_open
function.description: Open a web page in the browser (http/https) and wait for it to load. Returns the tab id, title, final URL, how much text/tables/links the page has, an excerpt, and whether it waits for the user (sign-in or human verification). Pass `tab` to load the address in an existing tab instead of a new one.

tab.description: Optional tab id (e.g. t1) to reuse instead of opening a new tab.

wait_for.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for, for pages that draw their content after loading.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the page (default 30).

function.name: browser_read
function.description: Read an open tab's current content and save it under scratch/browser/. `tables` saves each HTML or ARIA table as a CSV (headers detected) and reports their shapes; `markdown` gives the main content with headings, lists, links and tables; `text` the visible text; `links` every link (text and URL) as JSON; `html` the full DOM.

function.name: browser_eval
function.description: Run JavaScript in an open tab and return its JSON-serializable result: page-specific extraction, clicking a 'load more' or next-page button, choosing a filter, scrolling, or reading data the page already fetched. `script` is either one expression or the body of an async function that uses `return` (await is allowed). Results larger than a few thousand characters are saved to scratch/browser/.

script.description: An expression, or an async function body ending in `return value`.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the script may run (default 30).

function.name: browser_tabs
function.description: Manage the browser's tabs: `list` the open tabs; `check` a tab again (its URL, title, and whether it still waits for the user) after the user signed in or finished a verification; `show` brings a tab to the front for the user; `close` closes a tab you no longer need.

tab.description: The tab id, for check, show and close.
